guest_disk_full_acceptance.result: passed original sync and async SDK: actual guest errno 28; multipart text, seekable octet stream and nonseekable upload all raise NotEnoughSpaceException; concurrent control VM remains writable; same VM writes after releasing filler; refilled VM destroyed; new VM has clean test directory and writable disk

async_stream_acceptance.server_source_equivalence: production source unchanged between server build and test commit
async_stream_acceptance.host_and_artifacts: same host, Firecracker/jailer, base and server hashes as host_resource_acceptance
async_stream_acceptance.result: passed eight async IO uploads and four streamed downloads at zero/below/at/above limits with successful content hashes; 16 MiB command output completed, oversized output failed after 25133056 stdout bytes with one Start marker; FIFO/event-gated disconnect reconnected the same PID with one marker
async_stream_acceptance.sdk_difference: Async background wait can discard the underlying ConnectError chain. The probe accepts only the exact pinned SDK chunk-EOF rendering, with a smaller-output success control and independent health/no-replay checks. Composition tests reject ordinary deadlines, lookalike messages, authentication errors and a deadline cause.
async_stream_acceptance.residuals: successful VM and earlier classifier-failure VM independently audited: exact processes stopped; private jails/netns/cgroups absent; base hash unchanged
async_stream_acceptance.limits: Selected manual async KVM acceptance under 1 vCPU / 512 MiB guest / 768 MiB VMM limits; excludes final deployment budgets, concurrent slow transfers, full timeout parameter combinations and kill/expiry/revocation races.

transfer_interruption_acceptance.host_and_artifacts: same Linux/KVM host, Firecracker/jailer and fixed base fingerprints as host_resource_acceptance; server rebuilt at this exact commit
transfer_interruption_acceptance.regression: before the fix, kill returned successfully but a quiet command and paused upload remained open; API authority and cancellation subscription now share one management lock, and accepted kill/expiry cancels only that sandbox routes
transfer_interruption_acceptance.result: passed eight original SDK cases: sync/async x upload/download x kill/expiry. Each upload had 262144 bytes observed in the guest before interruption, then failed authentication after release; each 64 MiB download received a nonzero prefix and failed with RemoteProtocolError. Old-token health/files/Start rejected; independent control VM remained usable.
transfer_interruption_acceptance.sdk_difference: quiet command cancellation is rendered by pinned SDK as TimeoutException with the previously verified transport EOF shape; ordinary deadline errors are explicitly rejected, not counted as successful revocation
transfer_interruption_acceptance.normal_regression: same committed server passed sdk_server_smoke.py and sync/async sdk_data_contract.py using legacy configuration
transfer_interruption_acceptance.residuals: ten interruption VMs and four legacy VMs had live PID/start-time/cgroup identity and limits sampled; before each service exited, exact VM processes were stopped, private jails/netns/cgroups absent and no process held a recorded network namespace inode. Base hash unchanged. Earlier failed and first corrected runs separately audited after tests ended.
transfer_interruption_acceptance.limits: selected manual acceptance; generous explicit idle/admission test budgets separate lifecycle from transport timeouts. Does not cover all timeout arguments, concurrent lifecycle/restart races, host filesystem exhaustion or final budgets tied to frozen #13 tasks. No new Lean coverage.

transfer_pressure_acceptance.result: passed original sync and async SDK on two tenants: separate per-VM/global 429; health, SendInput, CloseStdin and SendSignal retain reserved capacity; EOF and signal release slots; rejected file and Start calls leave no effects. FIFO-blocked file headers yield 504, bounded writers unblock/remove the FIFO, and quiet commands complete normally.
